title: Core mechanic 2 - Aporrea (Mash)
description: Second core mechanic. Press the action button rapidly to fill a bar before the timer ends. Pure C# fill/win logic; simple-shape prefab; MicrogameDefinition asset. Follows unity-microgame-framework skill.
acceptance_criteria: Each press of the action button increments a per-player progress value; the bar is rendered with simple shapes.
Win condition: reach the threshold before time runs out; loss otherwise. Fill and win evaluation are unit-tested in pure C#.
A MicrogameDefinition asset registers it (verb e.g. '¡APORREA!') and it runs through the sequencer.
